_readme: S739 (wave A), the gap census's Next wave (census run 45771011713 of 2026-11-26 06:54Z, the reader_page_assignment and paid_read levers): 1 program of Copper Mountain College whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses and whose own page in the catalog's reissue of 2026-11-18 (college-page-read run 45783372680) names fewer than half of them by code, the catalog having renumbered the rest. Hospitality Management A.S.-T 41085 is pinned to its own page (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json, pdf_pages). Filed as named gaps and never sent to a paid read. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none). No model call, no Supabase write. Each is the college's to settle in COCI or its catalog, or waits on the reader change its reason names. Each carries the five confidence scores, 0 to 100, that kb/_program_named_gaps.py confidence() gives its filed record as it stands.

reasons.catalog_renumbered: The program's own page prints its courses under codes the college renumbered after the state's file was written, so the page names fewer than half of the state's listed courses by code and the capture refuses it as the program's page. It waits on course_renumbers pairs for the college (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json), each cited by the title and units both the catalog and the state's file print.

programs.title: Kinesiology
programs.note: Its own page (PDF p.107 of Final-26-27-Catalog-11.18.26r1.pdf, 'Associate in Arts in KINESIOLOGY for transfer') prints 'Required Core Courses' KINE 101, BIOL 022 and BIOL 023, six one-unit movement courses (KINE 058A, 54A, 057A, 032A, 039A, 047A), 'Restricted Electives' (CH 001A, STAT C1000 or SOCI 003, PH 002A or PH 004A, PSYC C1000, SOCI C1000) and 'Total Units for the Major 21-25'. It names 4 of the state's 11 listed courses by code (PH 2A, PH 4A, PSYC C1000, SOCI C1000); the state lists the other 7 as BI 23, PE 43, PE 45, PE 52, PE 91, PE 96 and PE 98. The filed record (run 39035222722, read from course-description pages of the 09.03.26 file) notes those descriptions name KINE 058A, 054A, 032A, 057A, 039A and 047A as formerly PE 043, 045, 052, 091, 096 and 098.
